fact: THISDAY reports the Bureau of Public Procurement has begun implementing a unified e-Government Procurement system for all federal public procurement, in phases.

BPP Director-General Adedokun said on 26 February 2026 that from 2 March 2026 the BPP moves fully to e-submission, MDAs are directed to create online submission platforms and must ask contractors to submit bids electronically.

BPP Director General Adebowale Adedokun said on 2026-10-08 that the electronic government procurement system being developed by the Bureau will move federal bidding fully online, with Education Ministry and federal university submissions already processed digitally on PCOMS.

The Bureau of Public Procurement said at a 2026-09-03 Abuja conference that its reform centres on an electronic government procurement system that would automate major stages of the procurement cycle across government, alongside a compliance platform called NOKOPO.
